What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers broken or defective parts on the wheel, cat tree, scratching post, or cat bed for 90 days from purchase. We provide free replacement parts during that period, and you don’t need to return the item.
It applies only to orders placed directly with us, not third-party sellers or distributors. If you choose to return the item instead, our standard return policy applies.
